notes.title: A Knight in the Attic Adds OpenXR - Now on MORE Headsets
notes.content:
[h1]A Knight in the Attic ... Now with OpenXR![/h1]

[h3]We're excited to share that we have implemented the [b]OpenXR[/b] plugin for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1318700/A_Knight_in_the_Attic/][b]A Knight in the Attic[/b][/url], to make the game playable for a wider variety of headsets and with more configuration options![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43102062/22548487980f2cbdcfa7a493d638c127911b5685.gif[/img]

We wanted to get this build out to make things more playable on a wider variety of headsets and while we still only support Quest [i]officially[/i], the OpenXR plugin will help people playing with virtual desktop and Valve Indexes, Pico and more.

It will allow also people to make their own controller configurations, and make sure that our cozy VR adventure can be enjoyed by folks who haven't had a chance to play it yet.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1318700/A_Knight_in_the_Attic/

notes.title: Update is Live: A Knight in the Attic Improvements & Enhancements 🐝 ✨
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Attic Adventurers![/h1]

[h2]We come with good tidings (and more details!) about the update just launched for [b]A Knight in the Attic[/b] 🐝  ✨[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43102062/22548487980f2cbdcfa7a493d638c127911b5685.gif[/img]

✨ ⚔️   In this patch, you’ll find we have made some notable adjustments & improvements to the game experience! 🐝  ✨

[b]Patch Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] New ‘Slow World Speed’ mode slows down all obstacles and enemies
[*] Beautiful new X-ray shader for Gwen
[*] Additional lighting & special effects details
[*] Bonus music and sound effects
[*] Up/Down locators added to Caption finder
[*] More fanfare on level end and transitions
[*] Bonus Lancelot appearance in the Mystic Forest 3 cutscene
[*] Adjustments to improve level and puzzle design
[/list]

[b]Other Patch Fixes + Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Guinevere now stops when receiving no input
[*] Loading bar is now disabled on main screen
[*] Bee gate trigger area made smaller
[*] Revision to tutorial position
[*] Changed sound emitters to be single rather than double on rotating bridges
[*] Geometry fixes on some textures
[*] Adjustment to sound emitters to follow on one axis to reduce overlapping sounds
[*] Fixed issue where character speed was affected by grabbing the board and using the joystick at the same time
[*] Fixed potential softlock at the Mystic Forest 3 teleporting flower
[*] Fixed issue where glass shatter sound played on loop
[*] Fixed certain geometry from clipping through the bottom of the board
[*] Fixed Various Audio issues
[*] Fixed Catapult not launching player correctly on Slow Player Speed
[*] Fixed Lag Spike upon opening Saves
[*] Re-added floating behaviour to Sword
[*] Fixed Audio trigger on Pickup Crank
[*] Fixed Bee Gate Requirement Text UI
[*] Fixed Glass wall break behaviour
[*] Fixed issue in final battle to do with Boss Attacks
[*] Fixed various ‘getting stuck’ issues on Tele Flower puzzles
[/list]

We're very excited to get this out to you on Day 4! Thank you for your feedback & reviews which are always appreciated; you can reach the developers directly at [url=mailto:support@mightyyell.com]support@mightyyell.com[/url].

We hope that you (continue to) enjoy the magic & mystery of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1318700/A_Knight_in_the_Attic/]A Knight in the Attic[/url]!

-- The Mighty Yell Team
